nodes.label: blur_data_url Design (new field, not blur_hash reuse)
nodes.rationale: Introduce an explicit blur_data_url field instead of reusing the existing blur_hash column: that name implies a different algorithm not directly compatible with next/image. If placeholder generation fails, the worker still produces large/thumb and leaves blur_data_url null.

nodes.label: Classic Pagination Design Decision
nodes.rationale: Classic query-string pagination is preferred over infinite scroll because it is more readable, indexable, shareable and already supported by the API contract (page/pageSize/meta.totalPages).

nodes.label: Suggestions Separated From Exact Results Design
nodes.rationale: Existing fallbacks replaced the list when empty; the design instead keeps exact results in items/meta and adds a separate optional suggestions section with declared reasons, avoiding duplicates and never confusing alternatives with requested results. If only the suggestions query fails, log and respond without suggestions rather than failing the response.

nodes.label: Cold Start Policy (dev-online minReplicas=0, production >=1)
nodes.rationale: dev-online may keep minReplicas=0 accepting cold starts to contain costs; production web and API must keep at least one warm replica; worker may stay at 0 if it only does controlled job/polling work.
